title: Cancer-associated fibroblasts promote thyroid cancer progression and reduce radioiodide uptake via lactylation.
publicationName: Drug resistance updates : reviews and commentaries in antimicrobial and anticancer chemotherapy
journalName: Drug resistance updates : reviews and commentaries in antimicrobial and anticancer chemotherapy
snippet: Radioiodine (RAI) therapy is a cornerstone of thyroid cancer management, but impaired iodide uptake limits its efficacy. How distinct cancer-associated fibroblast (CAF) populations alter tumor-cell iodide handling remains incompletely understood.
